newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up amid market operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up amid market operation.

text.p: Pakistan's interbank money market rates closed up on Saturday amid a shortage of funds and may open higher on Sunday as no major inflow is expected, dealers said.
Overnight rates held steady at 20 percent throughout the day and banks discounted an estimated 10 billion rupees from the State (central) Bank of Pakistan, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
A number of overnight deals were rolled over at 20 percent, the dealers said.
